description: Find companies with imminent capital raise needs based on estimated cash runway. Defaults to companies with less than 6 months of cash remaining, sorted by urgency (lowest runway first). Useful for identifying distressed companies, imminent dilution situations, or potential financing catalysts. Runway is estimated from current burn rate. Companies whose ESTIMATED cash is already exhausted are included by default and listed first: they carry cash_runway_months null with cashRunwayReason "estimate_would_be_negative" (the last cash figure, dated cashRunwayAsOf, rolled forward by the burn rate is below zero today). That is an estimate from a dated balance, never a reported zero balance — say "estimated exhausted as of today, last cash figure <cashRunwayAsOf>", not "has no cash". Rows also carry estimatedCurrentCash / estimatedCashAsOf (dilution-snapshot cash projection; null = not measured) and listingMarket.

includeExhausted.description: Include companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted (default: true)

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology", "Software")

market.description: Listing market: "otc" (OTC Markets) or "exchange" (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / Arca / Cboe)

maxMonths.description: Maximum months of cash runway to filter by (default: 6)

name: screen_must_raise
title: Screen Companies That Must Raise Capital
